🎥🎬: UNABOMBER (2026)

At just 16 years old, Ted Kaczynski is already a mathematical prodigy whose intelligence earns him a place at Harvard University. But behind his academic brilliance, Ted struggles to connect with others and find his place in the world. His experience at Harvard takes a disturbing turn when he becomes involved in controversial psychological experiments conducted by Professor Henry Murray, leaving a lasting mark on his already complicated inner world.

Decades later, America is gripped by fear as a series of deadly mail bombings sparks one of the FBI’s most extensive manhunts. FBI agent Joanne Miller becomes determined to uncover the identity of the elusive criminal, following clues that lead her toward a suspect whose past holds disturbing connections to the investigation.

Moving between Ted’s formative years and the relentless pursuit to capture him, UNABOMBER explores the troubling path from gifted student to infamous domestic terrorist. As the investigation closes in, the film examines the consequences of isolation, ambition, and the choices that leave devastating effects on countless lives.

source_details.synopsis: Unabomber is a 2026 American crime drama film directed by Janus Metz Pedersen and written by Sam Chalsen and Nelson Greaves. Based on the domestic terrorist Ted Kaczynski, the film stars Russell Crowe, Jacob Tremblay, Annabelle Wallis, and Shailene Woodley. Produced by 2.0 Entertainment and MRC Film, Unabomber was released in the United States by Netflix on September 25, 2026. The film received mixed reviews from critics.
